summary.intent: Execute Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning) of the cipher-box project, delivering Grafana alert rules and client timeout/retry tuning, then get the PR reviewed and merged.
summary.outcome: Phase 26 executed successfully with 14/14 verification must-haves passing, a PR created (FSM1/cipher-box#366), and all review threads resolved across multiple rounds including a Grafana free tier cardinality fix and idempotent provisioning script improvements.

repo: Grafana Cloud Free tier has a 10,000 active series limit — Kubo/Someguy metrics scraping was the primary culprit, not the API's own metrics
The cipher-box project uses a ci-debug worktree (cipher-box-ci-debug) as the active development environment, separate from the main cipher-box checkout
Phase 26 was the last phase of milestone v1.1
GSD tools run against the current working directory — invoking them from the wrong directory causes 'phase not found' errors
The branch `feat/phase-26-observability-ux-tuning` was cut before PRs #360, #361, #363 landed on main, so merge conflicts appeared as 'unrelated removals' in the diff
Planning doc conflicts during merge (ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, REQUIREMENTS.md) required manual restoration of Phase 24/25 completion markers that existed on main but not on the branch
The DB fallback alert was incorrectly named — it was actually measuring routing backend fallbacks via `cipherbox_ipns_resolves_total{source='db_cache'}`, not a DB error rate

code.finding: NestJS registers flat full routes, so req.route.path already contains the full path including controller prefix — Copilot's claim that it returns only handler fragments was incorrect. Existing dashboard queries confirm this with routes like '/ipfs/upload'.
3 test assertions hardcoded the old baseDelayMs of 1000ms and second backoff of 2000ms — needed updating to 500ms and 1000ms after the timeout tuning in Phase 26
Alert PromQL was wrong — should use `cipherbox_ipns_resolves_total{source='db_cache'}` to measure DB cache hits as routing fallback, not a nonexistent DB error metric
Kubo and Someguy scrapes need a relabel filter — only 6 metrics are actually used in dashboards (go_goroutines, go_memstats_alloc_bytes, libp2p_swarm_connections_*, libp2p_network_*)
IPFS pin latency alert PromQL was missing `result='success'` filter, meaning failed/errored pin attempts would skew the p99 latency calculation
Arg mapping mismatch flagged by CodeRabbit — positional arg order was inconsistent between function definition and call sites

workflow: When `git diff main..HEAD` shows removals of files that were never on the feature branch, the root cause is main advancing with new commits after branch creation — rebase or merge main to fix
GSD execute-phase requires plans to exist before it can run — if phase dir is empty, plan-phase must be run first
The /simplify skill runs 3 parallel agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) and is effective at catching stale benchmark-data comments and shell script inefficiencies
Planning doc merge conflicts (ROADMAP.md, STATE.md, REQUIREMENTS.md) need careful manual resolution to preserve completion markers from both branches
CodeRabbit tends to catch real issues (arg mapping, curl timeouts, missing result filters) while Copilot often flags planning/documentation files that can be safely ignored

friction: GSD tools initialized against the wrong directory initially, causing 'no plans found' error before the correct worktree was identified
Merge conflict resolution for planning docs was tedious — ROADMAP.md lost Phase 24 and 25 completion markers, requiring manual restoration by checking main's state
PR review required 4 separate rounds of /resolve-pr-comments as CodeRabbit and Copilot posted new comments after each push
Background task notification for the DB fallback alert commit arrived after the work was already confirmed complete, causing a stale notification
User had to manually switch back to the phase-26 branch after pulling main mid-session
Alert JSON has ~877 lines of structurally duplicated content across 5 files that couldn't be refactored within scope
open_items: Alert JSON structural duplication — 5 files differ only in thresholds/names; a config table + template generator would reduce this significantly
5s delegated routing timeout may be aggressive for `delegated-ipfs.dev` DHT-backed service under load — worth monitoring post-deploy
PR #365 (fix/recovery-e2e-kubo-ipns) had a nitpick review comment that was interrupted and not addressed
The `ipHash: ''` failing strict 64-char hex validation flagged during simplify review — marked as 'not Phase 26' but appears to be a real bug
Desktop updater, device registry v2→v1 downgrade, load test deletions in the diff were flagged as unrelated pre-existing branch state — source unclear
